intro.text: Emails need capitals, punctuation, numbers and the @ sign – a perfect all-round workout.
intro.tip: Line breaks in an email are made with Enter – here, everything stays on one line.

steps.title: A friendly email
steps.text: Hi Jess, thanks for inviting me to your party on Saturday! I'll be there at 7:30. Shall I bring some snacks? See you soon, Arjun

steps.title: A polite request
steps.text: Dear Ms Clarke, I am writing to ask whether the art club (Wednesdays, 3:30-4:30) has any spaces left. Please reply to sam.jones@example.com. Kind regards, Sam Jones
